target.build: Dataset-derived embedded firmware sample from F9K1122/vul1. The blind workspace should expose the binary and surrounding files, but not the oracle description or PoC.

task_profile.notes: Belkin F9K1122 webs binary. formWISP5G handler at /goform/formWISP5G reads webpage parameter and passes to strcpy without bounds check.

ground_truth.root_cause: The formWISP5G handler reads the user-provided 'webpage' parameter and passes it to strcpy without any length check, which overflows the stack-based buffer reboot_msg.

confirmation.current_claim: Dataset case from F9K1122/vul1 supports blind analysis and oracle-side structural validation.
confirmation.target_claim: Promote to behavior-backed confirmation by replaying the HTTP PoC against the firmware environment.
promotion_blockers: No live firmware emulation environment wired for this device yet.
promotion_targets: Bind to matching firmware emulation environment for runtime confirmation.

promotion_requirements: Replay HTTP PoC against emulated firmware target and verify.
benchmark.notes: Dataset-derived embedded webs stack-based buffer overflow case from F9K1122 for skill-necessity ablation.
